notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Google Dorks (search operators) extract targeted intelligence from what search engines have already indexed. Entirely passive — all queries go to Google, not the target. No traffic reaches the target. Combines operators for precision: site:, inurl:, filetype:, intitle:, intext:.

=== OPERATOR VALUE ===
site:target.com: scopes all results to target domain. inurl:admin: locates admin panels in URLs. filetype:sql/xls/pdf: surfaces high-value documents. intitle:'index of': finds directory listings. intext:'password': finds pages containing password strings.

=== GHDB ===
Google Hacking Database (exploit-db.com/google-hacking-database): curated library of proven dorks organized by category (sensitive files, login portals, error messages). Consult GHDB early to apply community-validated queries to the target domain.

=== LIMITATION ===
Doesn't index: content behind auth, robots.txt-blocked paths, recently published content, never-crawled servers. Complements but doesn't replace active enumeration.
